name: Meme
description: Silly, fast and reactive. GIFs, emoji, shakes and snap zooms where the joke lands.
vibe: Playful and chaotic on purpose, but every gag must land on a real moment in the transcript. Reaction GIFs (gif layers with a specific, funny query) or animated emoji right after a line that deserves a reaction, 1.5-2.5s each, beside the head, never on the face. Snap zooms (1.3-1.5) and the shake effect on punchlines. Captions one word at a time, big, bouncy. Use a different reaction every time; never repeat the same emoji. Kinetic words or a stamp effect for the funniest line. Still readable: never more than two overlays at once.
